2019.question: जो लड़का तुमसे मिलने आया था वह बहुत ही गरीब है।
2019.prashna: जो लड़का तुमसे मिलने आया था वह बहुत ही गरीब है।
2019.instructions: Direction (46- 50) - Choose the most suitable translation :

options.A: The boy who came to see you he was very poor.
options.B: The boy who has come to see you is very poor.
options.C: The boy who came to see you is very poor.
options.D: The boy who had come to see you was very poor.

vikalpa.A: The boy who came to see you he was very poor.
